## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this change and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New attack vector / detection rule
- [ ] Authorization policy / invariant improvement
- [ ] Performance optimization or documentation

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] All pytest test suites pass (`python -m pytest tests -v`)
- [ ] Frontend builds without TypeScript errors (`cd frontend && npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified defense invariants (patched behavior vs. vulnerable behavior)

## Maintainer Approval
*Note: Direct pushes to `main` are restricted. All contributions require maintainer review and approval before merging.*
